eligibility.quote:
Case 1: Structures having Eigen objects as members
Adding EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW to class declaration solves the problem
eligibility.reason: The plugin must meet an independently provided library's object-alignment precondition. The address supplied to Eigen construction is an API-boundary assumption, not an arbitrary internal arithmetic defect. The reported nodelet load is PAIR and supplies a concrete assertion failure.

failed_conditions.reason: The hunk adds the allocator macro to Bumper2PcNodelet. The issue's plain_array<float,4> assertion supports the fixed-size vector storage implicated by the specification; other is the supplied taxonomy's appropriate class for alignment.

loudness.quote: Assertion `(reinterpret_cast<size_t>(array) & 0xf) == 0 && "this assertion is explained here: " "http://eigen.tuxfamily.org/dox-devel/TopicUnalignedArrayAssert.html" " **** READ THIS WEB PAGE !!! ****"' failed.

detection_stage.reason: The posted assertion and nodelet-loader death occur while activating/constructing the plugin, not during message transport or compilation.

resolution.quote: Adding EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW to class declaration solves the problem
resolution.reason: This supports the repair, but does not identify the Eigen revision or demonstrate the specified 0.3.8/Eigen-3.0.5 pair working. The specification acknowledges that the maintainer's test-machine Eigen revision is unstated. Its observed status therefore exceeds the required two-revision evidence.

notes: Read issue #257 with all comments, the bumper2pc fix, the 0.3.7/0.3.8 headers and a794de9. The headers verify the macro addition, not a successful run. The later comment 'Believe or not, this is still alive: still can fail for very, very unlucky people.' is at https://github.com/yujinrobot/kobuki/issues/257#issuecomment-21234252. Commit a794de9 changes DockDrive in kobuki_auto_docking and states 'But the fact is that something is wrong on ecl.' That is a different composition, not proof that the selected bumper2pc fix failed or a missed condition in it. No adjudication relies on the unfetched ROS Answers/Wayback quotations in the specification.
